0022600165.text: The New Orleans Pelicans (2-4, 11th in the West) are on the road at the Memphis Grizzlies (6-0, 1st in the West), who have won six straight, while the Pelicans have won their last two. The Pelicans will be without Dejounte Murray (personal), Jordan Poole (ankle sprain), and Yves Missi (knee bruise), and the Grizzlies list Quinten Post (ankle) and Scotty Pippen Jr. (back soreness) as day-to-day game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and they split their 2025-26 series 2-2, with the Pelicans winning the last meeting 114-106 in New Orleans on January 30, 2026.
